thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-8421 for `hosted-inference-prod` - latency spike and 502s. Auto-escalation policy engaged. Details: https://pagerduty.example/PD-8421 :rotating_light:

alice oncall: saw this. I'm on the train, will try to ack in 2m.

incident-bot: PD-8421 auto-escalated to `bob secondary` after primary did not ack within 90s. Manager escalation queued if still unacknowledged in 5m.

bob secondary: acked. pinging now to confirm state. can anyone repro the 502s? 

alice oncall: trying to pull logs but mobile is flaky. thx for ack, bob.

bob secondary: digging — 502s across multiple hosts in the inference pool. kernel OOM-ish? seeing evictions in syslog. attaching relevant tail:```
[2026-03-15T09:12:23Z] inference-node-12 kubelet: OOMKilled container redwood-runtime
[2026-03-15T09:12:24Z] inference-node-05 proxy: upstream returned 502 for /v1/generate
[2026-03-15T09:12:25Z] autoscaler: scale loop: unavailable GPUs=3
```

carol manager: paging in — on my way. if manager escalation fires ping me as well. call me if bridge needed @carol :phone: 

incident-bot: Manager escalation triggered and notified `carol manager` at 4091234575 because secondary acknowledged but multiple host OOMs detected.

dave sre: removing one potential angle — recent rollout? I see a config change pushed 09:05 that increased per-request memory cap: `runtime.max_kv_cache=12GB` -> might increase process footprint. who rolled that?

alice oncall: that was me — small tweak to reduce cache churn for long context workloads. I only changed the flag in staging then rolled to prod at ~09:03. sorry, didn't anticipate memory pressure.

bob secondary: ok that explains OOMs. mitigation plan: 1) revert the flag on prod hosts 2) temporarily scale up nodes by +2 GPU to buy time 3) drain and restart the worst nodes.

emily product: customer impact: latency increase and elevated 5xx means some in-flight requests for active customers (enterprise account: acme-inc) likely failed. BAD for SLAs. we should surface to CS and mark incident P1 until we have mitigation.

dave sre: commands to run:```bash
# revert flag via deploy config
kubectl -n inference set env deploy/redwood-runtime RUNTIME_MAX_KV_CACHE=6GB
# scale pool
kubectl -n inference scale deployment/gpu-pool --replicas=$(($(kubectl -n inference get deploy gpu-pool -o jsonpath='{.spec.replicas}')+2))
# restart worst host pod
kubectl -n inference delete pod inference-runtime-12 --grace-period=30
```

bob secondary: running revert now. ETA ~45s for change to propagate.

ops-bot: scaling event requested by bob secondary: gpu-pool replicas -> +2. new replica creation started.

alice oncall: reverting flag now too. starting canary on 2 nodes.

20s later...

bob secondary: canary looks good on two nodes, no OOMs. 502 rate down ~80%. `acme-inc` request success rate improving.

dave sre: continuing to drain and restart the nodes that OOMed. monitoring disk and memory. no further OOM logs after revert.

emily product: contacted CS to prep messaging. not yet broad customer notification — will coordinate after we confirm stability for 15m.

carol manager: good job. keep P1 for now until we have 15m of healthy metrics. postmortem owner? alice oncall should take PM since config change initiated the issue — please take and we will review root cause and rollout guardrails.

alice oncall: will own the postmortem. will add timeline, revert, and a checklist for rollout memory safety.

incident-bot: PD-8421 status changed to `acknowledged` and is marked under investigation. Auto-close disabled until manual resolution.

bob secondary: last check: 5xxs back to baseline, latency within SLO on all zones. recommending to keep autoscale buffer +1 for next 2 hours while we watch.

dave sre: agree. also adding a temporary alert: `inference.memory.usage > 85% for 3m` to catch recurrence.

emily product: tagging acme-inc support case and prepping a brief PSR.

carol manager: thanks team. once we hit 15m stable metrics, we can de-escalate and document follow-ups in the PM.

alice oncall: metrics stable for 16m. lowering severity to P2 and notifying stakeholders. will start postmortem doc in #product-incidents. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
